paragraphs: The 220d has been part of the 2 Series range since the model launched in 2014. The first-generation F22/F23 (coupe and convertible) used the B47 2.0-litre diesel, which carried over into the current G42 generation from 2021. The B47 is a more reliable engine than the earlier N47 it replaced — timing chain issues that plagued the older engine are not a documented problem on this generation.
about.boldParagraph: The 220d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
